years pass, and they seem faster and faster. presence and time is all i can ask for. so grateful for what has passed, so optimistic for what’s to come. go love on the people you hold close to your heart, and don’t waste a second ❤️
2024, shower me with love and laughter, gratitude and growth, patience and presence
